name: Lijomol Jose
bio: Lijomol Jose (born 26 March 1992) is an Indian actress, who primarily appears in Malayalam and Tamil films. She earned critical acclaim for her role in the Tamil film Jai Bhim (2021), which won her a Filmfare Award.
